title: A local ring map reflects isomorphisms between finite free modules.
statement: For commutative local rings R and S, a local ring homomorphism f : R →+* S reflects isomorphisms between finite free R-modules: if scalar extension along f sends a linear map φ : M ⟶ N to an isomorphism, then φ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose finite bases for M and N. The scalar extension is represented by the same matrix over S; its inverse implies equal ranks and that the determinant maps to a unit of S. Locality of f reflects units, so the determinant is a unit in R. The adjugate identity then supplies an inverse matrix over R, hence φ is an isomorphism (including the zero-rank case).
